WadaiParam:10.note: Prefix of the default deck names: WadaiParam class>>init builds this + two full-width digits (0x824F+n) for decks 1-20 (so "話題袋０１"). Deck names are limited to 6 chars: DeckView>>setName shows at most 6 FontChars at a fixed 26 px pitch (unpatched, so English letters get uneven gaps) and NameEntry holds 3+3 cells; so prefix <= 4 chars. In DeckListItem the name is a TextLine (pitch 24) whose first glyph is 160 px left of the row centre and, in edit mode, the first counter sprite sits at the row centre: ~160 px of room; 6 JP cells = 144 px, minus 2 digits (48 px) = 96 px for the prefix.

WadaiParam:28.0.note: Name of the initial deck object (WadaiParam>>initialize). Shown like WadaiParam:10: DeckListItem TextLine pitch 24 (original 3 chars; room ~160 px, 6 cells = 144 px) and DeckView FontChar at a fixed 26 px pitch, hard cut at 6 chars.

GameParam:166.note: Default surname given to GameParam>>setMyouji at start-up (also feeds the speaker label of PLY). NameEntryEdit holds 3 cells for the surname and 3 for the given name (24 px FontChar cells); Parson>>setDispName: keeps only the first 3 chars. Names printed with {Nm}: message window, backlog, save list (ShioriListItem), credits. Max 3 chars / 72 px.

GameParam:167.note: Default given name for GameParam>>setNamae (printed by {Nn}). 3 cells in NameEntryEdit; max 3 chars / 72 px.
